_comment: Hand-maintained list of people aboard each crewed station (satellites-plan.md §4.1). Keys match catalog.ts ids. Set `updated` to the date you last checked (YYYY-MM-DD); null means not filled in yet and the UI will hide the count. `agency` keys into AGENCY_LINKS in catalog.ts (NASA, ESA, CSA, JAXA, CMSA; Roscosmos is shown unlinked). `since` is the docking date (UTC). Sources: NASA Expedition 75 and CMSA/Shenzhou-23 announcements. Recheck at the next station crew handover.
